rule: V7 is the single final runtime destination. Keep PAPER-only operation and authenticated execution disabled. Port any behavior still required by V7 into V7/common, validate it, collect same-SHA PAPER evidence, integrate that exact SHA to main, advance paper-validated, deploy and pass server health, then perform mass legacy deletion. Per-surface superseded code may be removed as soon as its V7/common replacement is proven. Git history is the archive. Do not create V8/V9/V10 or duplicate runtime, broker, ledger or scheduler ownership.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, executable depth, authoritative fees, spread/slippage, joint completion, partial/unwind loss, adverse markout, capital/latency costs, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

architecture.target: one slim canonical V7 PAPER codebase
architecture.legacy_rule: Do not restore V3/V4/V5/V6 implementations after a tested V7/common replacement exists. If a still-required primitive was removed prematurely, recover its behavior into V7/common rather than recreating a legacy compatibility layer.

economic_objective.multi_leg_rule: Estimate the empirical joint completion/state distribution; product or minimum of marginal fill probabilities is not an accepted substitute.
economic_objective.success: positive forward realized PAPER fill-conditioned post-cost PnL with causal data, simulated fills, authoritative fees, executable depth, partial/unwind losses, markout, cost stress and no leakage

model_contracts.fast_structural_arb: use event-driven/local L2 state where possible, separate exchange/receive/decision clocks, stale/sequence/reconnect continuity checks, authoritative per-market fees, executable depth, sequential or near-simultaneous leg revalidation and explicit partial/unwind accounting
model_contracts.graph_rv: prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; queue ahead reduces fillability and must not grant capital; compare maker/maker, maker/taker, taker/maker, taker/taker, sequential and near-simultaneous entry by total executable EV with explicit partial-state unwind
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; keep 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separate; frozen holdout model is fit once strictly before holdout_start minus embargo and never refit inside the frozen holdout; online walk-forward evidence is separate
model_contracts.micro_taker: complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs; open positions mark to full-depth executable liquidation net of exit fee or fail closed
model_contracts.external_intelligence: all features/probability mappings must be point-in-time; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved causal mapping and evidence
model_contracts.learned_execution: estimate P(fill|X,a), fill-conditioned markout and multi-leg joint state distributions empirically for join/improve/fade/cross/size/timeout/cancel/replace actions and expose them to all V7 strategies
model_contracts.micro_maker: selective incentive-aware maker only; report trading PnL, rewards and total PnL separately; unconditional always-improve is not alpha; queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, toxicity, cancel latency and adverse markout are required
model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: pair-specific panels, pair-excluded orientation-invariant factor basis, same-basis null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, horizon-matched forecasts and explicit execution economics

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence
frozen holdout evidence and adaptive walk-forward evidence must never be mixed

current_priority_order: Fix any bug or authority conflict that invalidates economic evidence or can trigger a wrong cutover.
Fast Structural Arb / HFT on synchronized event-driven executable books.
Graph/RV joint completion and queue-decoupled execution sizing.
Cross-sectional ranking 15m with a genuinely frozen holdout while keeping 30m/1h/2h/6h separate.
Selective Micro Taker with complete round-trip executable EV.
External Intelligence / fair-value collection in parallel with point-in-time provenance.
Learned execution model for fill, joint completion and markout.
Selective incentive-aware Micro Maker with trading PnL and rewards separated.
PCA and Local Factor refinements only where evidence warrants them.
Monitoring/Grafana polish on one canonical V7 surface.
Delete each superseded legacy surface after its V7 replacement is proven; perform mass legacy retirement only after the V7 same-SHA cutover is complete.

scheduler_assignments.administrator-supervisor: Treat this V7 master directive as authoritative, report collisions, and block stale immediate-delete or compatibility-restoration instructions.
scheduler_assignments.research-policy: Require V7/common-only new logic, PAPER-only/authenticated separation, exact-SHA evidence, causal data and the safe cutover-before-mass-cleanup sequence.
scheduler_assignments.research-queue: Prioritize evidence-invalidating bugs, Fast Structural Arb, Graph/RV completion, Ranking 15m, Micro Taker and External Intelligence; do not dispatch new V3-V6 feature work.
scheduler_assignments.promotion-controller: Promote only on exact-SHA forward/OOS executable economic evidence; CI or quoted edge alone is insufficient.
scheduler_assignments.integration-merge: Single-writer V7 integration only. Do not merge premature mass legacy deletion that blocks cutover, and do not restore retired implementations once V7 replacements are proven.
scheduler_assignments.control-plane-event-bridge: Dispatch only registered control-plane work; do not reinterpret GitHub Actions as a realtime HFT engine.
scheduler_assignments.post-merge-validation: Validate the exact integrated SHA, advance paper-validated only for that SHA, then deploy and server-health check the same SHA.
scheduler_assignments.code-validation: Validate V7/common contracts and reject V7 dependencies on legacy versioned runtime when a native replacement is available.
scheduler_assignments.monitoring-validation: Validate one canonical V7 Grafana/runtime-status surface with current SHA and executable economic metrics.
scheduler_assignments.alpha-factory: Rank challengers by forward/OOS executable economics and incremental utility; reject statistical or quoted-edge-only claims.
scheduler_assignments.meta-supervisor: Coordinate agents via GitHub, avoid duplicate lane ownership, and preserve single-writer authority surfaces.
scheduler_assignments.fast-arb-shadow-research: Prioritize synchronized event/exchange-time book state, executable depth, exact fees, latency, partial/unwind and cost-stressed PAPER evidence; server event loop owns sub-hour runtime.
scheduler_assignments.arb-theory-research: Derive structural/Graph opportunities under V7 execution contracts and explicit joint completion states.
scheduler_assignments.external-intelligence: Collect and chronologically validate public information in parallel; publish research evidence only and keep probability mapping fail-closed.
scheduler_assignments.live-api-smoke: Read-only connectivity only; no policy mutation or authenticated execution.
scheduler_assignments.v7-point-in-time-universe-archive: Keep V7 point-in-time archival research read-only and survivorship-safe.
scheduler_assignments.v7-unified-paper-evidence: Reconcile only an exact V7 source SHA into isolated PAPER evidence; do not mix evidence across SHAs.
scheduler_assignments.v7-cross-sectional-ranking-research: Keep frozen and adaptive ranking evidence separate; add 15m prospectively without pooling horizons.

forbidden_regressions: Do not reopen or restore the obsolete V7 $125 fixed trade cap or 5%/15%/70% caps.
Do not create V8/V9/V10 or another numerical runtime generation.
Do not mass-delete legacy before any still-required behavior has been ported and the V7 same-SHA cutover has passed deploy and server health.
Do not restore V3/V4/V5/V6 implementations after a tested V7/common replacement exists.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution.
Do not bypass kill switch, reconciliation, drawdown or state-integrity hard limits.
Do not create a second live state writer, broker owner, execution ledger, canonical integration or duplicated scheduler.
Do not call quoted edge, assumed fills, in-sample Sharpe or CI success profitable alpha.
Do not use product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities as a generic multi-leg joint completion estimator.
Do not mix frozen-holdout evidence with adaptive refits or pool ranking/PCA evidence across horizons.
Do not use stale or point-in-time-invalid market/external data.
Do not write scheduler-generated code or artifacts outside authorized repository/runtime/evidence paths.
